preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for word in ['Sand', 'Water', 'Fish', 'Sun'] for match in [input_str.lower().find(word.lower()) for word in [word]] if match != -1 and (match == 0 or input_str[match - 1].islower() or not input_str[match - 1].isalpha()))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of non-overlapping occurrences of the words 'Sand', 'Water', 'Fish', and 'Sun' in the input string, case-insensitive, without overlapping.
